entities.name: Ctirad Benáček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ctirad Benáček was a Czech basketball player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1948 Summer Olympics. He died in Auckland, New Zealand on 1 December 1999, at the age of 75.
